channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: RJ Scaringe on Why Rivian Bet Everything on Owning Its Own Software
item.dc:creator: Masters of Scale
item.description: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe explains the early call to build its own electronics and software, the $5.8 billion Volkswagen licensing deal, the R2 ramp, the Uber robotaxi plan and a self-driving roadmap that goes unsupervised next year.

item.title: A Used Hyundai IONIQ 6 for $21,000 Is Quietly One of the Best EV Deals Going
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Out of Spec helps Lacey buy a used IONIQ 6 SE with 24,000 miles for around $21,000, about $25,000 all-in. It is an 800-volt EV that still pulled past 200 kW on a DC charger. The catch is the ICCU.

item.title: GM and Peak Energy Built a Grid Battery That Cools Itself With No Fans or Coolant
item.dc:creator: Munro Live
item.description: GM is making sodium-ion cells in Warren, Michigan for a Peak Energy storage system that needs no liquid cooling. Modules stack on a tilt so heat rises and pulls air through on its own. Cheaper materials, decades of cycle life.

item.title: CATL Is Talking About a Battery With Almost the Energy Density of Gasoline
item.dc:creator: Ben Alexxander
item.description: CATL named lithium-air as a long-term research goal. Its theoretical energy density sits near gasoline at about 12,000 Wh/kg, and lab cells have reportedly topped 1,200 Wh/kg, several times today's packs. Likely a 2035-plus technology.

item.title: This Route 66 Fast Charger Runs on Sunlight With No Grid Connection at All
item.dc:creator: Scott Explains
item.description: Coral Charge built an off-grid solar fast-charging station in Barstow, California. Roughly 600 panels, battery storage in each unit and up to 180 kW out, with no utility hookup. Pricing runs 50 cents per kWh.

item.title: The Leapmotor B05 Is a Sub-€33,000 Electric Hatch Aimed at the Golf and Astra
item.dc:creator: Autogefühl
item.description: Autogefühl drives the Leapmotor B05, a compact electric hatchback priced from about €32,000 with a 67 kWh LFP battery, roughly 250 miles of real-world range and a 10 to 80 percent charge in around 18 minutes. It is sold through the same Stellantis dealers as the Opel Astra, and the cabin quality is the real surprise.

item.title: BMW's Concept M Neue Klasse Is a Preview of the Quad-Motor Electric M3
item.dc:creator: BMW M
item.description: BMW pulled the cover off the Concept M Neue Klasse at Le Mans, a near-production look at its first electric M3. It uses four motors, an 800-volt system and a battery over 100 kWh, plus new yellow headlight slashes and Track Lights set to spread across future M cars.

item.title: What Actually Happens to an EV Battery in an 84 km/h Crash
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Electrifying watched a Zeekr 7X get rear-ended at 84 km/h inside Geely's safety center in Ningbo. The cabin held, the doors still opened and the battery pack came through undamaged. The harder question is why EVs still cost more to insure when the packs are this tough.

item.title: Inside BMW M's Electric Nürburgring Testing, From Torque Vectoring to Engineered Sound
item.dc:creator: BMW Group
item.description: BMW M takes its electric prototype to the Nürburgring in the fifth episode of its development series. Four motors and one control unit allow torque vectoring with no delay, a new axle was designed for the load, and a team is building a performance sound that does not copy a combustion engine.

item.title: Will the R2 Be the Hit Rivian Needs? Jason Fenske and the InsideEVs Crew Weigh In
item.dc:creator: InsideEVs
item.description: The Plugged-In Podcast brings on Jason Fenske of Engineering Explained to talk Rivian R2 deliveries. The verdict is a simpler, cheaper R1S that fixes most of the big SUV's annoyances. The bigger question is whether Rivian and Lucid can survive the jump to volume.

item.title: Rivian Laid Out What Is Actually Coming to R2 Autonomy, From Auto Park to Point to Point
item.dc:creator: RivianTrackr
item.description: RivianTrackr talks to Rivian's autonomy lead at the R2 reveal. R2 ships with lifetime Autonomy Plus and Universal Hands-Free, UHF 2.0 in Q3 adds traffic-light and stop-sign control, off-highway lane changes and auto park, and point to point driving begins rolling out by year end.

item.title: Saul Griffith Lost His US Climate Funding. So He Wired Up One Australian Postcode Instead.
item.dc:creator: ABC News In-depth
item.description: Australian Story follows inventor Saul Griffith as Rewiring America's federal funding freezes after the 2024 US election. His answer is Electrify 2515, a community group near Wollongong helping 500 homes swap gas for electric appliances on solar, with savings of about 2,000 dollars a year.

item.title: The Changan S05 Lands in the UK at £37,990 With No Paid-Extra Trims
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric CARS
item.description: Everything Electric drives the new Changan S05, a compact electric SUV starting at £37,990 with a 68.8 kWh LFP battery and a 10 to 80 percent charge in about 20 minutes. Pick any seats, materials and paint for the same price, and the suspension was retuned for UK roads in Birmingham.

item.title: A Swarm of Underwater Turbines on the Rhine Is Making Power at Solar-Level Prices
item.dc:creator: German Science Guy
item.description: German Science Guy explains Energy Miner's swarm power plant, a cluster of small underwater turbines called energy fish anchored in the Rhine. It produces constant base-load power at about 8 cents per kilowatt hour, with plans to grow this stretch to 124 turbines.

item.title: Ford's Cheap Electric Truck Has Been Spotted, and It Looks Built Around Efficiency
item.dc:creator: Tailosive EV
item.description: Tailosive EV breaks down camouflaged spy shots of Ford's upcoming affordable electric truck. It rides low and aerodynamic on a universal platform with LFP structural batteries and a 48-volt system, targeting under 30,000 dollars, though dealer markups may push real prices toward 40,000.

item.title: The Long-Range Kia EV2 Drove 275 Real-World Miles, Past Its Own WLTP Figure
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Electrifying drove the 61 kWh EV2 across Norway until it gave up, shadowing the official Norwegian range convoy. It covered 275 miles at 4.56 miles per kWh, beating the lab claim, then raised a sharper question: with range this good, does anyone still need a bigger battery?

item.title: BYD's Flash Charging Reaches Europe With a Five-Minute Claim and a CCS Plug
item.dc:creator: Dan Latham
item.description: BYD is bringing its flash charging network to the UK and Europe, starting with a station in Bologna this week and around 300 UK sites to follow. The pitch is 10 to 70% in roughly five minutes, on a standard CCS plug any compatible car can use, with battery-buffered units that need no grid upgrade.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
